responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/dump.rs: Implements attribute-driven debugging dumps for the collect phase by traversing crate items and emitting diagnostics that print computed opaque hidden types, instantiated predicates, item bounds, and DefId parent chains, including anonymous const parents discovered inside body owners. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/generics_of.rs: Builds `ty::Generics` for HIR definitions during collection, choosing each item's generic parent, synthesizing or inheriting parameters for special forms such as RPITITs, delegation items, closures, const blocks, opaques, and anonymous consts, and detecting whether a definition has late-bound regions. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/item_bounds.rs: Computes explicit and elaborated item-bound clauses for associated types and opaque types, including inherited bounds from enclosing traits, remapping GAT-bound variables into the associated item's parameter space, translating trait RPIT projections back to opaques when needed, and exposing filtered bound sets used for self bounds, non-self assumptions, and outlives-only impl supertraits. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/predicates_of.rs: Collects generic predicates for items by lowering user-written where clauses and bounds, adding special inherited predicates for RPITIT trait and impl items, combining inferred outlives constraints, injecting the implicit `Self: Trait` predicate for traits, and computing const-condition predicate sets and implied `~const` bounds used by later checking. It is specifically responsible for ensuring children of opaque types and return-position `impl Trait` items inherit the predicates of the parent item when needed. This matters for generic const expressions inside opaque return types, where an anonymous const or associated const path such as `T::ABC` must see parent bounds like `T: Foo` in its parameter environment. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/resolve_bound_vars.rs: Resolves HIR lifetime and other binder references into the compiler's bound-variable model by classifying parameters as early, late, or free, assigning Debruijn indices across nested binders and trait-object elision scopes, recording late-bound variable lists and opaque captured lifetimes, and diagnosing invalid late-bound non-region parameters. It is also responsible for rejecting illegal captures of late-bound type or const parameters by nested opaque types and related binder constructs, including cases involving the `non_lifetime_binders` feature where an opaque or associated type constraint could otherwise carry escaping bound variables into later well-formedness predicates. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/type_of.rs: Computes `type_of` results for collected HIR owners by lowering declared types, determining the type of anonymous consts and const arguments from their surrounding HIR context, dispatching opaque-type hidden-type computation to the dedicated opaque collector, and producing placeholder-feature diagnostics for items whose type must be inferred or is otherwise invalid. compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/collect/type_of/opaque.rs: Finds and validates the hidden concrete type for opaque `impl Trait` definitions by scanning their permitted defining-use scopes, comparing constraints gathered from HIR type checking and MIR borrow checking, enforcing TAIT and associated-type opaque restrictions on generic arguments and reveal scopes, and reporting unconstrained or mismatched hidden types.
